:::{#exr-cv-estimate-by-fold}
#### The cross-validation estimate, fold by fold

Rewrite the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) @eq-cv-estimate
as $1/n$ times a double sum:
an outer sum over the fold numbers $j = 1, \ldots, k$
and an inner sum over the observations $i$ in [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{j}$.
Then simplify the summand, so that it no longer uses the fold assignment $\foldof{i}$.

:::
